FROM tb_att_result_n t, emp_master em WHERE em.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND t.employee_no = em.employee_number AND t.time_and_attendance_date BETWEEN to_date(#{atendanceStartDate}, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND to_date(#{atendanceEndDate}, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND em.date_hire_subsidiary <= to_date(#{atendanceStartDate}, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND (em.date_retire >= to_date(#{atendanceStartDate}, 'dd/mm/yyyy') OR date_retire IS NULL) AND NVL(em.fse_yn, 'N') <> 'Y' AND NVL(em.flsa_yn, 'N') <> 'Y'
AND em.attribute10 = #{shiftCode}
AND em.assignment_category = #{categoryTitle}
AND em.organization_id = #{orgId}
AND em.employee_number = UPPER(#{empNo})
AND UPPER(em.full_name_local) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{empName}) || '%'
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, trunc(t.time_and_attendance_date, 'MONTH'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{atendanceEndDate}, 'YYYYMM')),'month_total_ot_result') >= #{monthTotalOtFrom}
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, trunc(t.time_and_attendance_date, 'MONTH'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{atendanceEndDate}, 'YYYYMM')),'month_total_ot_result') <= #{monthTotalOtTo}
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, trunc(t.time_and_attendance_date, 'YEAR'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{atendanceEndDate}, 'YYYYMM')),'year_total_ot_result') >= #{yearTotalOtFrom}
AND lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code,em.employee_number, trunc(t.time_and_attendance_date, 'YEAR'), LAST_DAY(to_date(#{atendanceEndDate}, 'YYYYMM')),'year_total_ot_result') <= #{yearTotalOtTo}
) SELECT employee_org ,employee_no ,employee_name ,employee_grade ,actual_shift_code ,employee_category ,attendance_date ,year_ot ,month_total_ot
,weekday_day ,CASE WHEN weekday_day_over_m_raw > weekday_day_over_y_raw THEN weekday_day_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END AS weekday_day_over_m ,CASE WHEN weekday_day_over_m_raw > weekday_day_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE weekday_day_over_y_raw END AS weekday_day_over_y
,holiday_day ,CASE WHEN holiday_day_over_m_raw > holiday_day_over_y_raw THEN holiday_day_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END AS holiday_day_over_m ,CASE WHEN holiday_day_over_m_raw > holiday_day_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE holiday_day_over_y_raw END AS holiday_day_over_y

,public_holiday_night ,CASE WHEN ph_night_over_m_raw > ph_night_over_y_raw THEN ph_night_over_m_raw ELSE 0 END AS public_holiday_night_over_m ,CASE WHEN ph_night_over_m_raw > ph_night_over_y_raw THEN 0 ELSE ph_night_over_y_raw END AS public_holiday_night_over_y
